# Apps

Make connected tasks feel like parts of one understandable product, with continuity from first use to frequent use.

Organize navigation around the person's work and the objects they recognize. Establish a consistent visual and interaction language across screens. Make location, selection, unfinished work, and the effects of actions apparent as the person moves through the product.

Shape first use to give enough orientation to begin, and let familiar users return directly to their work. Give loading, empty, error, and recovery states a useful role in that same experience. Individual screens can have different densities and emotional tones while keeping shared controls and behavior recognizable.
